reviews.title: Easy to work with budget motherboard.
reviews.comment:
I paired the msi h610m with an i3 12100 ,gtx 1650 and Kingspec 3200mhz ddr4 ram and so far it smooth sailing all the way . I am able to play most games at 1080p medium to high settings .
What i love most of all is the EZ debug lighting that's let you know if there is an issue with cpu ,gpu ,ram or boot .loving it so far 5 stars.
